text:
You asked me about the Canberra weather, and it was partly cloudy with a high of 24°C. Since you were moving your desk setup into the spare room today, I prepared a checklist and saved it as a note called "Desk Move." We added details to that note, noting where the allen key is kept in the garage and the box of spare screws in the hallway cupboard. It sounds like things went smoother than anticipated, since the desk fit through the door without taking the legs off, which saved you like half an hour.

With Sprint planning at 2:00 PM and a quick sync with Marcus at 4:30 PM, you had the morning to set up everything before then. You also asked about the right monitor height for your neck comfort. I set a reminder for you to order cable ties or velcro straps at 7:00 PM tonight. We searched for where to recycle old cables and a broken monitor in Canberra, though the results were mostly general articles and none clearly listed a drop-off location yet.

For tomorrow morning, I have also set a reminder for Thursday 26 November at 9:00 AM to put the old desk chair out for the bulk pickup. It sounds like today went better than expected, so I hope you feel good about how smoothly the move went.
